summary: xAI announced that Grok 4.3 is now generally available to developers through Amazon Bedrock, including pricing, context window and reasoning-effort configuration details.

mechanisms.reason: Making Grok 4.3 available through a major cloud platform's inference service opens a new high-volume distribution surface that can add to aggregate token volume.
mechanisms.quote: Grok 4.3 is now generally available on Amazon Bedrock.

categories.reason: The announcement itself is the distribution of a frontier model through AWS's Bedrock platform, which is exactly the case where the platform relationship is the story.
categories.quote: Today, we’re excited to announce that Grok 4.3 is now generally available on Amazon Bedrock.

practices.reason: Teams already using Bedrock now have a documented endpoint and auth pattern to add Grok 4.3 as a model option, but this creates optional not mandatory work.
practices.quote: Grok 4.3 is now available to all developers in supported AWS Regions .

practices.reason: The post cites specific third-party benchmarks used to support the model's enterprise-readiness claims, which an engineer could look up but not directly reproduce from this text.
practices.quote: #1 on Artificial Analysis Omniscience benchmark*, achieving the lowest hallucination rate among frontier models.
